items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: His name was Robinson. He was primarily an automotive mechanic. And he was an older fellow. And as I said, they didn't have money enough to hire a hall or have a place of their own, so this old man was just good enough to allow them to use the back room of his garage.

ctx.x: One other question -- do you remember who the musician was whose garage 767 was in?
